title.zh: 复盘：给预告片留一句“尚未确定”
title.en: Review the preview beside what remains unknown

paragraphs.zh: 沿用手作课的小作品，给想象画面挑一个喜欢的细节，再补一句当前已知和一句尚未确定。比如“作品摆上桌”旁边保留“报名已确认，作品还没做”。画面可以留着，也可以换一个，不必改成待办。这里只看哪种讲述让你觉得好玩，不检查之后有没有实现；任何人是否出现、愿不愿参与，都仍需要另行确认。
paragraphs.en: For the workshop creation, choose an enjoyable detail in the preview, then add one known fact and one unknown. Beside the piece on a table, keep the booking confirmed and the piece not yet made. Retain or change the image without making it a task. Review the telling’s amusement without checking eventual fulfilment; anyone’s presence or participation still needs separate agreement.

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果一张纸模型还没完成，你会给它怎样的十秒预告，又用哪一句话说明现在只是在想象？”每人给虚构物件一句字幕，再各用一句话区分想象和已知。可以只读例子、换一种入口或不玩，不需要讲真实私人经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “For an unfinished paper model, what ten-second preview would you imagine and which sentence would identify it as imagination?” Give a fictional object a caption and distinguish imagination from known facts in another sentence. Read, choose another entry point or skip without describing private experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：同一个动作能有两种字幕
title.en: Review two captions for the same action

paragraphs.zh: 回到圈日历的动作，试一句夸张的片场字幕，再用一句普通事实描述它。可以把镜头拉近到笔尖，也可以用“今天先停机”收尾；不需要拍摄或发给谁。两种字幕改变的是讲法，日期是否合适、活动是否确认没有因此改变。复盘只选一处喜欢的声音或画面，不把自己或别人固定成故事主角。
paragraphs.en: For circling a calendar date, try a cinematic caption and a plain factual sentence. Zoom the imagined shot to the pen or end with filming finished for today, without recording or sending anything. Captions change the telling, leaving the date’s suitability and confirmation unsettled. Pick a sound or image you enjoy without assigning yourself or another person a fixed starring role.

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果镜头里只有一支笔圈了一个日期，你会配哪句小字幕，再怎样用普通一句话说清实际发生了什么？”每人给虚构物件一句字幕，再各用一句话区分想象和已知。可以只读例子、换一种入口或不玩，不需要讲真实私人经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a shot showed only a pen circling a date, which caption would you add and how would one plain sentence describe what occurred?” Give a fictional object a caption and distinguish imagination from known facts in another sentence. Read, choose another entry point or skip without describing private experiences.

paragraphs.zh: 沿用掉出的旧书签，先说“我看到了什么”，再说“我添了什么讲法”。一句故事在眨眼可以停在这里，不必再找颜色、编号或下一次巧合作印证。你也能把书签放回原处。复盘关注哪一处修辞有趣，活动是否仍存在、是否想参加则留给实际信息；别人的简短回复不由这朵火花解释成承诺或同意。
paragraphs.en: For the fallen bookmark, distinguish what you saw from the telling you added. A story’s imagined wink can stop without further colours, numbers or coincidences as confirmation. Put the bookmark back if you wish. Review a playful phrase while leaving the activity’s existence and your participation to actual information. Another person’s short reply becomes no promise or consent through the spark.

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果一张旧书签刚好掉到喜欢的一页，你会怎样分别写“发生的事”和“自己添的一句小玩笑”？”每人给虚构物件一句字幕，再各用一句话区分想象和已知。可以只读例子、换一种入口或不玩，不需要讲真实私人经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If an old bookmark fell onto a page you liked, how would you separately describe the event and a small joke you added?” Give a fictional object a caption and distinguish imagination from known facts in another sentence. title.zh: 复盘：明信片上的标题仍可改

paragraphs.zh: 回到只翻开两页的速写本，先给它一个未来视角的临时标题，再想象另一版：后来只画一张，或换了爱好。两张想象明信片都能留下，不用评哪张才算成功。可以只在脑中换标题，不必留档。复盘看时间视角怎样改变讲法，不给未来的自己安排交作业，也不替任何人决定将来会在合照里。
paragraphs.en: For the sketchbook opened to two pages, try a provisional title from later, then imagine only one drawing or another hobby. Both imagined postcards can remain without deciding which is success. Change titles mentally without keeping a record. Review how viewpoint changes the telling without assigning future homework or deciding who will appear in a later photograph.

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果今天只翻开一本旧速写本，你会给它怎样的未来明信片标题，又怎样让以后换标题也自然？”每人给虚构物件一句字幕，再各用一句话区分想象和已知。可以只读例子、换一种入口或不玩，不需要讲真实私人经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If you only opened an old sketchbook today, which future-postcard title would you try and how could changing it later feel natural?” Give a fictional object a caption and distinguish imagination from known facts in another sentence. title.zh: 复盘：续篇和结束可以并排
title.en: Review a sequel beside an ending

paragraphs.zh: 沿用旧活动草案，给它“也许还有第二幕”和“这页可以先合上”两个并排标题。再想象留下一个小点子用于完全不同的事，看看讲法是否也成立。无需重新召集、联系旧伙伴或恢复承诺。复盘只比较哪句读起来有趣；没有续篇不是失败，已经停下的安排也不会因一个结果名自动重启。
paragraphs.en: For the old activity draft, place perhaps another act beside this page can close. Imagine retaining one idea for an unrelated use and see whether that telling fits too. No gathering, contact with former collaborators or renewal of commitments is needed. Compare enjoyable wording; no sequel means no failure, and a result name automatically restarts no arrangement.

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果一个旧读书活动草案再次出现，你会给它哪两句标题，让“也许有续篇”和“可以停在这里”同时成立？”每人给虚构物件一句字幕，再各用一句话区分想象和已知。可以只读例子、换一种入口或不玩，不需要讲真实私人经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If an old reading-event draft reappeared, which two titles could leave room both for a sequel and for stopping here?” Give a fictional object a caption and distinguish imagination from known facts in another sentence. title.zh: 复盘：小亮点不必抵消不方便
title.en: Review a bright spot without cancelling inconvenience

paragraphs.zh: 回到临时发现的书摊，分别留下“走错了路”和“看到一点新东西”。可以给第二句一个幸运支线的标题，也可以撤掉；不要求喜欢书摊、购买或继续绕路。复盘关注这两句话能否同时保留，不用后来有没有惊喜替讲法验收。不便仍是不便，真实路线和时间安排仍按现场信息决定。
paragraphs.en: For the unexpected bookstall, retain both the wrong turn and noticing something new. Give the latter a lucky-side-path title or remove it without liking the stall, buying anything or continuing the detour. Review whether both descriptions can coexist without a later surprise validating the telling. Inconvenience remains, and routes and time follow actual information.

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果想象中走错巷子看到书摊，你会怎样给它一个可擦掉的标题，同时保留“也可以直接返回”的结尾？”每人给虚构物件一句字幕，再各用一句话区分想象和已知。可以只读例子、换一种入口或不玩，不需要讲真实私人经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “In an imagined wrong alley with a bookstall, which erasable title would you try while keeping an ending where you simply return?” Give a fictional object a caption and distinguish imagination from known facts in another sentence.
